title: 2017 ACC/AHA High Blood Pressure Clinical Practice Guideline

definitions.Resistant Hypertension: BP >130/80 on ≥3 antihypertensive drugs including diuretic
definitions.White Coat Hypertension: Elevated office BP with normal out-of-office BP
definitions.Masked Hypertension: Normal office BP with elevated out-of-office BP

recommendations.text: Lifestyle modifications (weight loss, DASH diet, sodium reduction, physical activity, moderation of alcohol) are recommended for all adults with elevated BP or hypertension.
For adults with confirmed hypertension and known CVD or 10-year ASCVD ≥10%, a BP target of <130/80 mmHg is recommended.
For adults with confirmed hypertension without CVD and 10-year ASCVD <10%, a BP target of <130/80 mmHg is reasonable.
In adults with Stage 1 hypertension and CVD or 10-year ASCVD ≥10%, antihypertensive drug therapy is recommended.
First-line antihypertensive drugs include thiazide-type diuretics, CCBs, ACEi, or ARBs.
RAS blockers (ACEi or ARB) are recommended in patients with hypertension and diabetes or CKD.
Combination therapy of ACEi with ARB is not recommended in hypertensive patients.
For adults with resistant hypertension, addition of spironolactone or eplerenone is recommended as fourth-line agent.
Out-of-office BP measurements (home or ambulatory monitoring) are recommended for confirmation of hypertension diagnosis.
In adults with hypertension and HFrEF, ACEi/ARB/ARNI plus beta-blocker plus MRA are recommended as preferred agents.
In adults with hypertension and stable ischemic heart disease, beta-blockers, ACEi, or ARBs are preferred agents.

pharmacotherapy.examples: lisinopril 10–40 mg, enalapril 5–40 mg, ramipril 2.5–10 mg
pharmacotherapy.indication: First-line; preferred in DM, CKD, HFrEF

pharmacotherapy.examples: losartan 25–100 mg, valsartan 80–320 mg, irbesartan 150–300 mg
pharmacotherapy.indication: First-line; preferred in DM, CKD, HFrEF (ACEi-intolerant)
Post-MI, HFrEF, angina; not preferred first-line for uncomplicated HTN

key_trials.name: SPRINT
key_trials.finding: Intensive BP target <120 vs <140 reduced CV events 25% and all-cause mortality 27%

key_trials.name: ACCORD
key_trials.finding: Intensive BP <120 in DM did not reduce CV events vs <140

key_trials.name: ALLHAT
key_trials.finding: Chlorthalidone equivalent to amlodipine and lisinopril for primary CHD events

key_trials.name: ONTARGET
key_trials.finding: Telmisartan non-inferior to ramipril; combination increased adverse events
